findings.summary: isPublished(articles.get(slug)) crashes the build when a /blog/<slug> link targets a slug not present in the articles map.
findings.mechanism: stripLinksToDrafts calls isPublished(articles.get(match[1])) at line 51; Map.get returns undefined for any slug that doesn't match a filename (typo, renamed/removed post, or non-article blog route). isPublished then does `article.draft` on undefined at line 33, throwing a TypeError and failing the entire Astro build rather than just skipping/logging that link.

findings.summary: isPublished omits the import.meta.env.DEV bypass present in the canonical apps/web/src/utils/data-utils.ts it claims to mirror, so draft/future links are stripped in local dev too.
findings.mechanism: data-utils.ts's isPublished short-circuits with `import.meta.env.DEV || ...` so draft/scheduled content is visible while developing. This new copy (line 32-36) has no such bypass, so during `pnpm dev` internal links to a post the author is actively drafting/previewing get silently flattened to plain text, diverging from 'the same rule the rest of the site applies' that the task explicitly asked for.
